summary: The legal integer has at most 10 decimal digits, which is too narrow for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; the accepted source processes each digit once while maintaining two accumulators.

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted source converts at most 10 decimal characters and performs one constant-time update for each retained digit, establishing O(D) time over the complete legal width bound.
The dedicated regression compares the accepted adapter with independent arithmetic digit extraction for every n from 0 through 1,000,000 and deterministic values spanning the complete legal range.
